GOAL: ground-truth DoL character creator UX + reactivity for our customization redesign (option A). v0.5.10.10, SugarCube 2.36.1 (= OUR engine version).

CREATOR UX = single inline form, sectioned (Body/Head/Skin/Sensitivity/Personality + world Basic-Settings). Each row: terse label : opt | opt | opt (radio buttons) + a one-line CONSEQUENCE note ('Larger sizes have higher max physique'; 'Purely cosmetic. Change later in mirror'). Live sidebar paperdoll preview + per-section Randomise buttons. RTS-flat in spirit: specific, consequence-tagged, not flowery.

3-AXIS IDENTITY is LITERALLY 3 separate creator fields: Genitals (Penis/Vagina/Both -> $player.sex m/f/h, PERMANENT) ; Gender (Male/Female/Neither -> $player.gender, SELF-IMAGE, UI text: 'Does not affect how other people perceive you') ; the 3rd axis gender_appearance is NOT in the creator -> it is $player.gender_appearance=undefined at creation, DERIVED to 'f' at game start from body+clothes. Proven: chose gender=n, got gender_appearance=f.

REACTIVITY PROOF (mirror): chose Gender=Neither but mirror prose reads 'A cheerful girl stares back' — 'girl' comes from PERCEIVED gender (gender_appearance=f), 'cheerful' from demeanour=Gentle. The prose word tracks DERIVED state, not the stored self-image.

DESCRIPTOR LAYER PROOF (wikified widgets against build sex=h/gender=n/breastsize=4/penissize=3): <<breasts>>='pert breasts', <<breastsizedesc>>='pert', <<penis>>='small penis', <<pussy>>='vagina', <<pcGender>>='orphan' (non-binary mapping), <<pcSex>>='hermaphrodite'. Conditional '<<if $player.penisExist>>has a <<penis>><</if>><<if $player.vaginaExist>> and a <<pussy>><</if>>' => 'has a penis and a vagina'. ONE authored line renders any anatomy, no branching.

LOCK RULE: genitalia + feat-boosts PERMANENT (load-bearing/gate content); ALL cosmetic (body shape, demeanour, hair, skin, breast/ass size) editable in-game via Mirror -> 'Examine your body'. Confirmed live: mirror re-exposes body-shape + demeanour radios mid-game.

Body-part SIZE LIMITS in creator (Breast: Flat-Enormous range slider; Ass: Slender-Huge): player sets the BOUNDS of future transformation, not just the start value. A consent/ceiling control we have no analog for.

SIDEBAR meters are banded value->word (trait_status_text-equivalent): Pain 'You feel okay', Arousal 'You feel cold', Fatigue 'You are refreshed', Stress 'You are serene'. Same banding mechanism our trait_bar has but DoL spends it on prose words, all the time.

OUR-ENGINE GAP CONFIRMED LIVE: our @player.body_type would print 'curvy' literally; DoL never stores/echoes a word — it stores sex='h'/breastsize=4 and DERIVES 'pert breasts'/'hermaphrodite'/'orphan' via widgets. The missing layer is the widget/descriptor layer (layer 2), exactly as the source research said. Native SugarCube Template ?token API available on 2.36.1 = low-engine-cost path.
